observations: Photo 0: Front view of a Toyota pickup with TRD-style grille and fog lights; headlights and grille are visible.
Photo 1: Front 3/4 view; Toyota badge on grille; headlights and bumper details visible.
Photo 2: Rear view; tailgate shows 'V6' badge; '4x4' badge not clearly readable; tow hitch/receiver area visible.

read_from: photo 2 tailgate shape and 'V6' badge consistent with Tacoma

claims.claim: foreign used 2024 toyota tocoma trd 4x4 with v6 engine
claims.evidence: Photos show a Toyota Tacoma pickup and a 'V6' badge on the tailgate (photo 2), but the model year (2024) and TRD/4x4 trim are not verifiable from the provided images.
No photo shows the keyless/push-button start area or dashboard/ignition controls.
No photo shows the roof/overhead console or moonroof opening.
No customs/duty documentation is shown in the photos.

risks.risk: Trim/4x4/engine spec mismatch (e.g., not actually TRD 4x4, or different V6 variant) which changes value.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the vehicle’s VIN plate and the dashboard/door-jamb sticker showing trim/engine, or a screenshot of the VIN decode.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used Tacoma V6 pickup with unknown trim/4x4 capability.

risks.risk: Model year not actually 2024 (could be different year), affecting market value.
risks.proof: Photo of the VIN plate with year, or a document showing registration year (or a VIN decode screenshot).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not-confirmed year (worst case within typical used range).

risks.risk: Push-to-start feature may not exist (or may be non-functional).
risks.proof: Photo/video of the push-button start (button visible) and a start-up video.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming push-to-start is not confirmed/possibly not working.

risks.risk: Moonroof may not be present or may be faulty (leaks, stuck mechanism).
risks.proof: Photo of the roof/moonroof controls and a video opening/closing the moonroof.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming moonroof is not confirmed (worst case: not working/absent).

risks.risk: Duty/customs status may be unverified (risk of unpaid duty, documentation issues).
risks.proof: Photos/scans of duty payment receipt, customs clearance documents, and any import paperwork tied to the VIN.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if duty verification is not provided (worst case: buyer may need to regularize).

risks.risk: Condition risks not visible: accident damage, frame issues, engine/transmission health, and mileage.
risks.proof: Full inspection photos (engine bay, undercarriage, chassis/frame, gearbox area), odometer close-up, and a cold-start video.
risks.if_unproven: Price as average/unknown condition with no proof of mechanical soundness.

proof_requests: VIN plate close-up (photo) + VIN decode screenshot showing year, trim, drivetrain, and engine.
Odometer close-up photo and a cold-start video.
Photo/video showing push-button start and moonroof opening/closing (if present).
Customs/duty verification documents tied to the VIN (receipts/clearance).
Undercarriage/frame inspection photos (no lifting points hidden) and engine bay photo.
response.reason: The photos confirm it is a Toyota Tacoma and show a 'V6' badge, but key pricing drivers (2024 year, TRD/4x4 trim, push-to-start, moonroof, and verified duty) are not verifiable from the images. Without VIN/year/trim and duty documents, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
